zi_wu.text_de: Rat-Horse (Zi-Wu): Water clashes with Fire. Emotional instability, impulsiveness, changes of direction. Relationships come under pressure. High potential for change.

chou_wei.text_de: Ox-Goat (Chou-Wei): Earth clashes with Earth. Financial losses, conflicts in partnerships. Foundations are shaken. A new orientation is needed.

yin_shen.text_de: Tiger-Monkey (Yin-Shen): Wood clashes with Metal. Travel problems, legal disputes, personal conflicts. High energy, but at odds with itself.

mao_you.text_de: Rabbit-Rooster (Mao-You): Wood clashes with Metal. Broken relationships, separation. Creativity and strictness in conflict. Emotional losses are possible.

chen_xu.text_de: Dragon-Dog (Chen-Xu): Earth clashes with Earth. Turbulence at home and in the family. Real estate matters get complicated. A transformative force.

si_hai.text_de: Snake-Pig (Si-Hai): Fire clashes with Water. Health problems (especially heart/kidneys), chronic stress. Spiritual crises and breakthroughs.

zi_chou.text_de: Rat-Ox (Zi-Chou): The strongest stabilizing combination. Building finances, reliable partnerships, teamwork. Geared to the long term.

yin_hai.text_de: Tiger-Pig (Yin-Hai): A creative and idealistic bond. Artistic projects, altruistic goals, romantic energy. Can be naive.

mao_xu.text_de: Rabbit-Dog (Mao-Xu): A romantic Fire combination. Deep bonds of love, passion, mutual loyalty. Very favorable for marriage and partnership.

chen_you.text_de: Dragon-Rooster (Chen-You): A powerful financial combination. Wealth through precision and strategic thinking. Career high points. Analytical strength.

si_shen.text_de: Snake-Monkey (Si-Shen): Intelligence and strategy. Planning and execution. Good for technology, research, medicine. Competitive.

wu_wei.text_de: Horse-Goat (Wu-Wei): Passion and empathy united. Social activities, adventure, lively love. Expansive, joyful energy.

zi_wei.text_de: Rat-Goat (Zi-Wei): Emotional misunderstandings in relationships. Care goes unacknowledged. Communication problems.

chou_wu_harm.text_de: Ox-Horse (Chou-Wu): Financial setbacks through impulsiveness. Instability in career plans. Impatience sabotages what is being built.

yin_si.text_de: Tiger-Snake (Yin-Si): Hidden hostility, intrigue. False friends. Caution with new partnerships and contracts.

mao_chen.text_de: Rabbit-Dragon (Mao-Chen): Creative energy is hampered by structure. Artistic frustrations, bureaucratic obstacles.

shen_hai.text_de: Monkey-Pig (Shen-Hai): Intellect and idealism in conflict. Strategies founder on reality. Financial disappointments.

you_xu.text_de: Rooster-Dog (You-Xu): Perfectionism meets loyalty, and each undermines the other. Quality problems despite good intentions.

jia.text_de: Jia period: growth, new beginnings, expansion. Favorable for starting a career and for long-term projects. Direct energy, no detours.

yi.text_de: Yi period: a diplomatic approach, social networking, artistic development. Indirect paths to success.

bing.text_de: Bing period: visibility, fame, public recognition. A passionate phase, the fire of ambition. Risk of overdoing it.

ding.text_de: Ding period: precision, inner fire, spiritual depth. Less spectacular but lasting. Good for quality work.

wu.text_de: Wu period: stabilization, consolidation, grounding. Building financial security. Little room for spontaneity.

ji.text_de: Ji period: care, detailed work, administration. Favorable for family matters. Risk of getting overinvested in details.

geng.text_de: Geng period: strength, assertiveness, forcing decisions. Career opportunities through courage. Conflicts possible.

xin.text_de: Xin period: aesthetics, perfection, refinement. A good phase for creative professions, finances through quality. Emotional sensitivity runs high.

ren.text_de: Ren period: freedom, expansion, intellectual curiosity. Travel, international connections. The difficulty: staying focused.

gui.text_de: Gui period: intuition, withdrawal, inner transformation. Strong spiritual development. Outward success takes a back seat.

zi.text_de: Zi Luck Pillar (Water): intelligence and intuition in focus. A good phase for study, research, strategic thinking. Emotional depth.

chou.text_de: Chou Luck Pillar (Earth): endurance, patience, slow but sure building. Favorable for real estate and long-term investments.

yin.text_de: Yin Luck Pillar (Wood): bold expansion, willingness to take risks, travel. Opening up new territory, taking on leadership roles.

mao.text_de: Mao Luck Pillar (Wood): gentle diplomacy, artistic flowering, social harmony. Relationships deepen. A quiet but fruitful phase.

chen.text_de: Chen Luck Pillar (Earth): transforming Earth, Dragon energy. Major turning points in life, leaps in career possible. A visionary phase.

si.text_de: Si Luck Pillar (Fire): strategic thinking, deep work, activating hidden powers. An often underestimated but powerful period.

wu_branch.text_de: Wu Luck Pillar (Fire): energy, travel, freedom. An eventful phase, many changes. Love matters are active but fickle.

wei.text_de: Wei Luck Pillar (Earth): creativity, care, artistic sensitivity. A family-oriented phase, with emotional fulfillment in the foreground.

shen.text_de: Shen Luck Pillar (Metal): cleverness, opportunism, quicksilver flashes of insight. Good for trade, technology, quick gains. Caution: rash action.

you.text_de: You Luck Pillar (Metal): precision, perfectionism, quality work. Financially very strong. Risk: social isolation through high standards.

xu.text_de: Xu Luck Pillar (Earth): spiritual maturity, loyalty put to the test, justice in focus. A phase of karmic balancing. Good for inner work.

hai.text_de: Hai Luck Pillar (Water): generosity, spiritual openness, endings and new beginnings. Deep inner cleansing. Favorable for creative and spiritual pursuits.
